exposure: BMI group (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² vs. BMI < 30 kg/m²)
outcome: Post-operative complications (classified using the Clavien-Dindo classification system)
cohort: 304 women who underwent a mid-urethral sling (MUS) surgery for stress urinary incontinence (SUI) repair at a tertiary university medical center between 2012 and 2018
finding: Obesity was not associated with increased rates of peri-operative or post-operative complications following MUS surgery for SUI repair.
